description: List emails in a mailbox. Defaults to your primary mailbox; pass `mailbox` to read a sub-addressed mailbox under your namespace (e.g. if you are 'vogel', you can read 'vogel-fitlog-test'). Reads outside your namespace return 403.

before.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — return emails before this time

mailbox.description: Mailbox local part (without @chaprola.org). Defaults to your primary mailbox. Must be your username or a sub-addressed '{username}-<suffix>'.

name: chaprola_email_inbox
